_comment: P1 Lighthouse CI gate. Runs in the dedicated `lighthouse` CI job (downloads headless Chrome in the GitHub runner) against the BUILT dist/ served by lhci's static server — so it never touches offline dev or the core frontend/backend jobs. The HARD perf gates are deterministic and stay `error`: the gzip-exact bundle budget (scripts/bundle-budget.mjs, npm run budget) plus resource-summary:script:size + unminified-javascript below. The category SCORE is variance-prone on throttled CI hardware (the rich landing page measures ~0.7 desktop on the throttled runner, ~0.9+ on real hardware), so it is a `warn` runtime signal — not a build-breaker — like accessibility/best-practices. minScore is calibrated to the measured CI baseline so the warning only fires on a real regression below it.
